UPDATE orgs
            SET default_deferred_execution =
                    COALESCE($2, default_deferred_execution),
                call_timeout_ms =
                    CASE WHEN $3 THEN $4 ELSE call_timeout_ms END,
                max_call_timeout_ms =
                    CASE WHEN $5 THEN $6 ELSE max_call_timeout_ms END,
                updated_at = now()
          WHERE id = $1
